project.title: Secure Facilities Service Management Platform Rollout
project.objective: Design and deploy a secure internal platform to manage facilities housekeeping requests, tracking, and reporting across departments.
deliverables: Requirements specification for facilities service management platform
Secure system architecture and data flow design
MVP implementation of web-based request and tracking portal
Integration with identity management and access controls
Housekeeping operating procedures and cleaning checklists in the system
User training materials and pilot rollout report
constraints: All data must comply with internal security and privacy policies
MVP must support only internal network access initially
Go-live for pilot within 30 days from project start
Solution must integrate with existing identity provider
Housekeeping staff require simple, mobile-friendly interface
Minimal disruption to current manual request process during transition

risks.risk: Platform introduces new security vulnerabilities in internal network.
risks.mitigation: Perform threat modeling, security review, and penetration testing before pilot; enforce hardening guidelines.

risks.risk: Housekeeping staff struggle to adopt the new digital workflow.
risks.mitigation: Co-design simple UI, provide training sessions, keep paper fallback during pilot, gather feedback for iteration.

risks.risk: Integration with identity provider is delayed or more complex than expected.
risks.mitigation: Define minimal viable integration scope, prototype early, and agree on clear interface with IT operations.

risks.risk: Requirements creep from multiple departments extends scope beyond MVP.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize core use cases, maintain a backlog for post-MVP features, and get sign-off on MVP scope.

risks.risk: Insufficient logging and audit trails for compliance.
risks.mitigation: Define logging requirements upfront and validate against internal audit expectations before go-live.

themes.why_relevant: Security roles must ensure the new platform is compliant and resilient from the start.
Housekeeping staff need practical, efficient digital workflows that match real-world tasks.
Analyst and manager roles must align stakeholders on MVP scope and priorities.
Developers and administrators must design a robust, maintainable, integrated solution.
Successful rollout depends on clear communication, training, and gradual process transition.

backlog.task: Gather and document functional and non-functional requirements for the facilities service platform
definition_of_done: Workshops held with facilities, housekeeping, and IT stakeholders
Requirements document reviewed and approved by facilities management
Security and compliance requirements explicitly captured
MVP scope clearly marked and agreed

backlog.task: Design secure system architecture and data flows for the platform
definition_of_done: High-level architecture diagram created and stored in shared repository
Data flow diagrams including authentication and authorization paths completed
Architecture reviewed with ICT system administrator and security stakeholders
Identified security controls mapped to each component

backlog.task: Define housekeeping service categories, SLAs, and digital workflows
definition_of_done: List of service categories (cleaning, maintenance support, special requests) documented
Target response and completion times agreed with facilities management
Step-by-step workflows for each category described in plain language
Workflows validated by at least two housekeeping team members

backlog.task: Implement MVP web application for request submission and tracking
definition_of_done: Users can submit, view, and update housekeeping requests
Housekeeping staff can see assigned tasks and update status
Basic reporting view for facilities management implemented
Code committed to version control and passes automated tests

backlog.task: Configure secure hosting environment and access controls
definition_of_done: Application environment provisioned in line with IT standards
Firewall and network rules configured for internal-only access
Role-based access control integrated with identity provider
System hardening checklist completed and signed off

backlog.task: Create digital cleaning checklists and standard operating procedures
definition_of_done: Room-type specific cleaning checklists drafted
Checklists reviewed with facilities management for completeness
Checklists uploaded or configured in the platform
Housekeeping team briefed on new digital checklists

backlog.task: Define logging, monitoring, and incident response procedures for the platform
definition_of_done: Logging requirements documented for key events
Monitoring dashboards or alerts configured
Incident response runbook drafted and shared with IT operations
Test incident drill executed and lessons captured

backlog.task: Plan and coordinate pilot rollout with selected departments
definition_of_done: Pilot scope and participating departments agreed
Pilot timeline and communication plan documented
Success criteria for pilot defined and approved
Feedback channels for pilot users established

backlog.task: Optimize UI and workflows based on housekeeping feedback
definition_of_done: Feedback from at least three housekeeping staff collected
Usability issues prioritized and addressed in the UI
Updated version deployed to test environment
Housekeeping confirms improved usability in follow-up session

backlog.task: Document end-user training materials and quick reference guides
definition_of_done: Step-by-step guides for requesters and housekeeping created
Short FAQ covering common issues compiled
Materials reviewed by facilities management and IT operations
Training content uploaded to internal knowledge base

backlog.task: Conduct security review and approve platform for pilot
definition_of_done: Vulnerability scan and basic penetration test completed
Security findings documented and critical issues resolved
Access control and logging verified against requirements
Formal sign-off for pilot recorded

backlog.task: Implement integration hooks for future analytics and reporting
definition_of_done: Data model for requests and completion times documented
API or export mechanism for analytics implemented
Sample report generated using test data
Facilities management validates that data meets reporting needs

artifacts.title: Housekeeping Digital Workflows and SOPs

artifacts.title: Room and Area Cleaning Checklists

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on MVP scope, key requirements, and success criteria for the platform.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and requesting input on requirements and MVP scope.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final MVP feature set and explicitly defer non-MVP items to a later phase.
Approve the initial success criteria documented in the pilot rollout plan.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Converge on secure architecture, hosting approach, and access control model.
threads_plan.trigger: ICT system developer shares draft architecture diagrams for review and comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the hosting environment and confirm internal-only access for the pilot.
Approve the role-based access control model and logging requirements.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and refine housekeeping workflows, categories, and digital checklists.
threads_plan.trigger: Domestic housekeeper posts draft service categories and workflows for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the final list of housekeeping service categories and SLAs for MVP.
Approve the initial set of digital cleaning checklists to be configured in the system.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate development progress, usability feedback, and UI adjustments.
threads_plan.trigger: ICT application developer shares a link to the MVP prototype and asks for usability feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which usability issues must be fixed before pilot and which can wait.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan pilot rollout, training, and go/no-go decision for the pilot launch.
threads_plan.trigger: ICT system analyst posts draft pilot plan and training approach for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot departments, start date, and go/no-go based on security review results.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async standup where each role posts yesterday-today-blockers updates.
Weekly architecture and security checkpoint to review changes and open risks.
Pilot readiness review one week before planned pilot start to confirm go/no-go.
Post-pilot retrospective summarizing feedback, incidents, and next-phase priorities.
